findings.comment: Overhead electric distribution line shown on site plan, but no building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor elevations are provided. Clearance compliance cannot be verified without documented conductor heights and building projection elevations.

Overhead electric line shown adjacent to buildings. Building elevation sheets showing surveyed overhead conductor locations and building projection details are not provided. Compliance with 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances cannot be verified from plan geometry alone.

Overhead electric distribution line exists on site adjacent to proposed buildings. Building elevation sheets with surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors are not provided. Required building elevation sheets must include conductor elevations and clearance dimension annotations to demonstrate required clearances are met.

applicableAreas: all site features near OHE line
findings.comment: Overhead electric line shown on site plan but no section or enlarged plan detail exhibits are provided showing dimensions from outer electric conductor to buildings and building projections. Clearance verification requires sectional views with conductor and building elevations labeled with clearance dimensions.

applicableAreas: two Type III driveways crossing western OHE line
findings.comment: Two Type III driveways at site entries/exits cross the overhead electric line. No vertical clearance dimensions are shown on site plan or grading plan. No survey data from registered surveyor documenting mid-span clearances is provided. Compliance with 18-foot minimum vertical clearance (for areas with truck traffic) cannot be verified without detailed clearance survey.

applicableAreas: overhead electric line on site plan
findings.comment: Overhead electric line is shown on site plan but no clearance dimensions are annotated from the outside conductor to any buildings, features, or site improvements. Plans must include explicit dimension lines and callouts showing measured clearances from the outer conductor (not pole centerline) to all affected site features.

Vertical clearance from overhead electric line to driveway grades and building elevations appears potentially marginal based on plan geometry. Registered surveyor survey data documenting pole locations, conductor elevations, and mid-span clearances is not provided. Mid-span clearance verification is required when vertical clearance compliance is not self-evident.

Overhead electric distribution line exists on site and construction is proposed. Required note per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 stating that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines is not included on cover sheet or general notes.
